title: Peapack-Gladstone Financial Corporation to Host First-Quarter 2026 Earnings Call
summary: BEDMINSTER, NJ - April 15, 2026 ( NEWMEDIAWIRE ) - Peapack-Gladstone Financial Corporation (NASDAQ: PGC), the holding company for Peapack Private Bank Trust, will host a conference call to review first-quarter 2026 financial results on Thursday, April 23, 2026 at 11:00 a.m. (ET). The results are scheduled to be released on Wednesday, April 22, 2026, after the market close. The live audio webcast and presentation slides will be available on www.peapackprivate.com under About Us, Investor Relations, Latest Events. A replay will be available under the Events Presentations section. About the Company Peapack-Gladstone Financial Corporation is a New Jersey bank holding company with total assets of $7.5 billion and assets under management and/or administration of $13.1 billion as of December 31, 2025.
